prompts.prompt: Which part came from the tap?
prompts.answer: Only rt is added water. V₀ was already present before the timer started.

prompts.prompt: Does double the time mean double the total water?
prompts.answer: It doubles the added water, but the starting amount is counted once. Total volume is proportional to time only when V₀=0.

definition.setting: An affine quantity model for nonnegative elapsed time; illustrated by a tank with constant inflow.

signature.r: constant inflow in liters per minute

conditions: Elapsed time is nonnegative and measured in minutes.
The stipulated inflow is constant and nonnegative; there is no outflow during the interval.
Initial volume and rate have compatible units; the tank has enough capacity for the result.
definition.domain_notes: General affine functions may have negative inputs or slopes. This tank renderer uses initial 0–100 L, inflow 0–20 L/min and time 0–12 min. With nonzero V₀ the function is affine; some algebra texts call every straight-line function linear.
definition.proof_status: A stipulated constant-rate model: add initial volume and rate multiplied by elapsed time.

grammar.pronunciation: V of t equals V zero plus r times t
grammar.formation_rule: Multiply rate by elapsed time to get added volume; add initial volume with the same unit.

scopes.domain_condition: t≥0, V₀≥0, r≥0 in this filling model

parse_errors.reason: Volume and volume per minute cannot be added without a time factor.
The story starts at time zero; negative elapsed time is outside its domain.

invariants: At time zero, output equals initial.
At zero rate, output remains initial.
